leah.sales: Enterprise prospect (Azure) wants a 10-day Dedicated POC. Hard requirement: single outbound IPv4 (one /32) for their perimeter allowlist. They also want separate env tokens (dev/poc) and a short lead-time + SOW snippet. Any blockers?
dmitri.eng: We can issue per-environment scoped API tokens and set TTLs for POCs. No blockers on tokens.
susan.net: Single /32 is doable if we pin the egress gateway. On Azure best path is a reserved Public IP attached to a NAT Gateway. Important: to guarantee the IP we must disable cross-AZ failover and constrain the cluster egress path. We'll call this out in the SOW.
leah.sales: Can we offer an alternative with zero public IP?
susan.net: Yes  Private Endpoint (VNet peering) => no public egress. That requires their infra team to accept peering and route to our endpoint; lead time is longer.
omar.solutions: SOW bullet you can paste: "Provision temporary Dedicated cluster (N GPUs) constrained to a single egress gateway to guarantee a static outbound IP (one /32); allocate reserved public IPv4; generate time-limited API tokens scoped per environment; run connectivity smoke tests; provide monitoring access. Customer to add provided IP and hostname to perimeter allowlist."
leah.sales: Any sample allowlist lines and quick smoke-test I can send to customer?
susan.net: Recommend both IP and hostname in case their proxy validates SNI:
ALLOW TCP 443 to 198.51.100.250/32
ALLOW HOST: dedicated-prod.redwood.example.com
And a quick curl they can run after allowlisting:
```
curl -X POST https://dedicated-prod.redwood.example.com/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <POC_TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-3b","input":"healthcheck"}'
```
dmitri.eng: Note: if they require absolute zero chance of rotation we must include an explicit constraint: "no cross-AZ failover; single egress gateway only". This reduces HA but satisfies strict allowlists.
leah.sales: Lead time estimate if SOW signed today?
susan.net: Fast path (static IP + timeboxed tokens): ~2-3 business days (reserve IP, create cluster, attach NAT, generate keys, smoke tests). Private peering path: 4-10 business days depending on customer's network approval.
provision-bot: Created ticket PROV-9987 to reserve IP 198.51.100.250 and schedule Dedicated cluster. Assigned to susan.net. ETA 72h. :white_check_mark:
leah.sales: Thanks all  I'll propose two options to the customer (A: static /32 + timeboxed tokens; B: private peering/no public IP) and ask which they prefer. Will share signed SOW once they pick.
